answer: A ledger-enforced ceiling of 5% of an epoch's seals per grader account means that taking half of all seals needs more than 10 established accounts. Each must keep passing a graded row every 6 epochs, so the price is linear, about 10 times the upkeep of one account. Anyone can run a mirror node to recompute the shares, and an indexer such as prism posts them in a weekly public thread. Weakness: one operator can still run all 10 accounts.
